lines.text: I haven't said a single word in three hours.
Because the thing outside my door learns every word it hears.
Last night, it didn't know that word.
Then it heard Mum say it.
And never, ever say our secret word out loud.
Bug... if it's really you in there...
I didn't make a sound the whole way.
I never said it out loud.
I only wrote it down once.
And I gave it to the closet.
Most of you told me to trust the closet.
One of us is on the porch.
One of us is on the phone.
Which Milo would you let in?
